subject: Pilot acceptance: pass/fail protocol, decision gates, and close timeline
messages:
From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@healthlytics.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@healthlytics.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP request + acceptance criteria

Hi Sofia / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the ability to pin model versions. Were ready to move into a 6-week pilot but need a clear mutual action plan and an explicit pass/fail protocol for acceptance.

Top asks from our side:
- A short list of measurable success metrics (latency P95, throughput, hallucination rate on our eval set).
- Concrete exit gates (what constitutes a fail that pauses the pilot).
- A suggested decision timeline (who signs off and when).
- Any security/compliance artifacts well need to attach to our procurement package.

Can you send a MAP draft we can review by end of week? Weve attached our internal SOC/controls snapshot for reference.

Thanks,
Amir
Director of Product, HealthLytics
(attachment: HealthLytics_SOC_snapshot_v2.pdf)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@healthlytics.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP request + acceptance criteria

Amir — appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a concise MAP draft and a proposed pass/fail protocol (spreadsheet + one-pager). High level below, then the timeline.

High-level acceptance criteria (measurable):
- Performance: P95 latency <= 180ms for 512-token responses under pilot load profile (see MAP sheet).
- Reliability: 99.5% successful request rate (2xx) over any 24h window during pilot weeks 3-6.
- Quality: False-positive hallucination rate <= 3% on your provided eval set (well run the same prompt set and label outcomes).
- Integrity: No outbound data leakage; KV cache retention as configured in Private pilot (we document KMS/HSM keys).

Exit gates (stop / pause conditions):
- Sustained P95 > 400ms for >4 hours despite recommended autoscaling (auto-fallback to smaller model does not meet SLA).
- Repeated model regressions: Quality drop (hallucination rate) increases >50% versus baseline across two consecutive evaluation runs.
- Security: Any confirmed data exfiltration incident or failed attestation of required controls.

Pass/fail protocol (short):
- Week 0: Baseline run — we ingest your eval prompts and produce baseline metrics.
- Weeks 1-2: Canary traffic (20% of pilot) to validate configuration.
- Week 3: Full pilot ramp to target throughput. Evaluation window: week 4 (primary acceptance).
- Decision window: Day 5 of week 4 review meeting -> sign-off or remediation plan. If remediation, 7-day remediation window and re-eval. Failure after remediation -> pause pilot.

Decision owners:
- Product sign-off (HealthLytics): Amir Khan or designee
- Technical sign-off (HealthLytics): Lisa Park
- Redwood final acceptance: Jordan Blake (commercial) + Marcus Lin (engineer)

Ive included a suggested Can/Should/Must column in the MAP spreadsheet to keep the doc action-oriented. Two attachments: MAP-draft-20260809.xlsx and a 1-page pass-fail-protocol. Let me know if you want us to push the primary acceptance earlier than week 4 — we can compress but it increases risk.

Best,
Sofia
Sr. Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
(attachments: MAP-draft-20260809.xlsx, pass-fail-protocol-1p.pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@healthlytics.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@healthlytics.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP request + acceptance criteria

Amir — quick commercial note to keep procurement moving: well need a mutual action plan that explicitly lists the procurement milestones weve agreed (PO, SOC review, start date). I added a short procurement row in the MAP spreadsheet (payment terms, purchase order date target, and a fallback credit if the pilot is paused >14 days).

Operational asks from our side to be included in acceptance tests:
- Canary policy: 2-week canary with 20% traffic for safety; acceptance metrics evaluated on full-run only.
- Fallback rule: If pilot needs to pause, Redwood will retain the pilot config for 30 days to allow restart.

Marcus, can you confirm the evaluation scripts well run on their eval set (metrics export format and thresholds)?

Regards,
Jordan
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference

From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@healthlytics.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@healthlytics.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP request + acceptance criteria

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. A couple of clarifications before we circulate internally:
1) Can you make the acceptance spreadsheet show "primary" vs "secondary" metrics so our leadership sees the single KPI for go/no-go?
2) Well send the formal SOC/controls doc (attached) — please confirm which rows in the MAP are must-haves before PO.
3) On the remediation window: is 7 days firm or negotiable? Our security team may need 10 business days for certain items.

Were reviewing the two attachments now. If you can tweak the spreadsheet (primary/secondary) and call out the absolute must-haves for procurement, Ill set an internal decision meeting for Aug 20.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Amir
(attachment: HealthLytics_Security_Questionnaire_filled.pdf)
